chunk_sequence_split_trajectory: chunk a sequence of camera indices into segments by distance, time delay, and max length constraints
chunk_sequence_filter_by_distance: split trajectory indices into chunks where inter-sample distance exceeds a maximum threshold
chunk_sequence_filter_by_time: chunk camera sequence indices by maximum time delay between consecutive captures in seconds
unpack_batches_extract_tensors: unpack a list of batch dicts into stacked tensors for images, canvas, rasters, yaws, and UV coordinates
unpack_batches_convert_uv_to_xy: extract batch data and convert UV ground truth coordinates to XY using canvas to_xy methods
